workload: c1 greedy decode, single resident sequence
gate: bit-exact vs eager across 120 tokens (growing KVLiveSpans cache)

method.approach: whole-step hipGraph capture (24-layer loop + final norm + lm_head + argmax) via MapleGraphCache
method.stateless_basis: KVLiveSpans ABI passes live/token_positions/evict/row as device pointers read at graph-exec time; eager span update + embed run before each replay

results.notes: Noise-dominated on c1; kernel-bound decode leaves only ~4% host gap to recover. Repeated interleaved runs ranged 0.99x-1.10x. Graph is bit-exact but not a robust c1 win; kept as opt-in infrastructure for M6 batch decode.
